build_ConvBlock: build a residual 2D convolutional block with weight-normalized bias-aware conv layers and skip connections
build_UpConvBlockDeep: build a 2D upsampling convolutional block with bilinear upsample and residual skip connections
build_ConvDownBlock: build a 2D downsampling convolutional block with stride-2 convolutions and residual skip connections
build_UpscaleNet: build an image super-resolution network using conv blocks and pixel shuffle upsampling
build_PixelShuffleWN: build a weight-normalized pixel shuffle upsampling layer with ICNR initialization for super-resolution
